description: This source file implements the IdentityTokenClaimService class, which generates JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for authenticated users by retrieving user information and roles, creating claims, and signing the token.

classes.name: IdentityTokenClaimService
classes.description: A service class responsible for generating JWT tokens for users based on their username, utilizing claims and security credentials.

methods.name: GetTokenAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a JWT token for the specified user by username, including user roles as claims, and signs the token with a symmetric security key.
